title: Added missing notes about including latest translations in 6.0.4 and 6.0.6.
body:
#### Trac ticket number
<!-- Replace XXXXX with the corresponding Trac ticket number. -->

N/A

#### Branch description
Latest translations strings were fetched from Transifex for 6.0.4 (9969df4f360221fc408da1604f0369f7594a1818) and for 6.0.6 (dd895d6268f1dd544a565a321cb4527ca3ca1173) but the release notes did not mention this.
